scope: Pinned source and patch replay only; unaccepted PMIC BCL draft
reviewed_changes: Build full pinned factory PMIC BCL and stats sources using real native thermal private layout/accessors and actual IPC logging provider
Propagate NVMEM, revision, IRQ, zone and monitor-write errors; own per-device resources and remove stale allocation globals
Serialize ADC callbacks and publish successful samples only; wide intermediates and clamp before narrowing CCM requests
Remove unused auxiliary ADC reads from logical level callback to avoid redundant bus traffic and same-class nested sensor locks
Read BPM wire snapshot explicitly little endian and commit only after successful HOLD/read/CLR; release HOLD after read failure
Track native IRQ action/wake ownership and preserve actions across freeze/restore; own debugfs subtrees and drain callbacks before log teardown
Retain native wake ownership when disable fails; rollback only newly acquired references and retry without double acquisition; preserve trigger stats on failed rearm
Abort a threaded IRQ after a sleeping status read when removal has started
Declare a managed parent regmap supplier device link so the native core unbinds/drains BCL before parent driver resources are destroyed
